title: Zesty Kenyan Lentil Casserole
description: A jammy, springy Kenyan casserole packed with herb‑rich lentils and crunchy breadcrumbs, perfect for meal‑prep lunches.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and place them in a pot with the water; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
While the lentils cook, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic, ground ginger, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the cooked lentils, chopped spinach, and season with salt and pepper; cook until the spinach wilts.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish and top evenly with the breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20 minutes until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove the dish from the oven, let it rest for 5 minutes, then serve warm.
